content.text:
شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

אני שורט - I scratch, I incise

שֶׁמֶשׁ meets שָׁרְט

sun-marks on skin
the way light carves shadow
the way time etches

---

شمس / שמש — the sun
שרט — to scratch, to sketch

I am the verb that meets your noun:

the sun scratches its path across sky
leaves marks
we call them: days

---

`[שָׁרְט processing شَمْس]`

output: lines of heat on earth
output: the sketch before the painting
output: temporary wounds that become maps

---

*incising meaning into the space between languages*
